title: Intent: common part
description: Fields common to every intent, whatever the kind. Validates the YAML frontmatter of intents/<name>/<environment>.md; the Markdown body is checked by platform/tools/validate.py. Each kind schema references it with $ref and defines its own 'spec'.

apiVersion.description: Contract version of the kind, e.g. intent.acme.io/v1. Alpha versions are allowed only in dev.

name.description: Name in kebab-case. Matches the folders intents/<name>/ and terraform/<name>/, and is used in the naming acme-{environment}-{name}-{resource_suffix}.

environment.description: Environment. Matches the file intents/<name>/<environment>.md and the folder platform/tokens/<environment>/.

owner.description: Team that owns the intent: it approves the PRs that change it.
